privacy.ai_training_note: Slack does not train LLMs on customer data. Direct quote from AI Principles page: 'Your Customer Data in Slack (like messages and files) are not used to train LLMs.' For generative AI, 'Slack will not use Customer Data to train generative AI models unless Customer provides affirmative opt-in consent.' For traditional (non-generative) ML models such as emoji and channel recommendations, customer data may be used in aggregate/de-identified form but customers can opt out by emailing feedback@slack.com. LLMs are hosted inside Slack's own AWS environment via an escrow VPC: 'The LLMs we use are deployed inside Slack's cloud environment, so model providers do not have access to your data.' Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is used, meaning data is sent only at inference time and not retained.
privacy.data_region: US and EU data residency options available; enterprise customers can choose the country or region for encrypted data at rest. Other international transfers documented (Australia, Canada, Japan, India, South Korea, US).

security.name: Encryption at rest and in transit
security.value: Yes, by default for all plans. 'In Slack, customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit by default.'

security.name: Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
security.value: Available on Enterprise Grid plans. Customers can bring their own encryption keys via Slack EKM.

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: HackerOne (active since 2014). URL: https://hackerone.com/slack. Paid program with more than $210,000 in historical payouts.

security.name: Native Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
security.value: Native DLP included; also supports third-party DLP providers.

security.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
security.value: Supported with domain claiming and enterprise mobility management (EMM) integration.

security.name: Legal hold and eDiscovery
security.value: Global retention policies, legal holds, and eDiscovery support available.

security.name: AI content safety
security.value: Slack AI Guardrails: 'a set of built-in foundational protections including content thresholds, safety instructions, context engineering, URL filtering, and output validation.' Real-time Content Safety Filters analyze queries before reaching LLMs.

security.name: LLM data isolation
security.value: 'Customer data never leaves Slack's trust boundary.' LLMs deployed inside Slack's cloud environment via AWS escrow VPC. Model providers cannot access or retain customer data.

security.name: AI admin controls
security.value: 'Admins can enable or disable AI features, giving customers full control over how and whether AI is used in their workspaces.'

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Not explicitly disclosed on public pages. Bug bounty program via HackerOne supplements external security testing. Enterprise white paper references 'network security and server hardening, administrative access control, system monitoring, logging and alerting.'

products.name: Slack Free
products.data_scope: Limited message history; basic workspace data. AI features limited to basic conversation summaries.
products.notes: Free tier. No DLP, no audit logs. Same encryption baseline applies. DPA still available.

products.name: Slack Pro
products.data_scope: Full message history. Basic AI: conversation and thread summaries, huddle notes.
products.notes: Paid per-user. First paid tier. No enterprise compliance controls.

products.name: Slack Business+
products.data_scope: Full message and file history. Advanced AI features: channel recaps, search, translations, Slackbot, enterprise search, Salesforce integration.
products.notes: As of June 2025 pricing update, advanced AI is now bundled (previously a separate add-on). Business+ includes SSO, DLP, and audit logs. Suitable for regulated industries with correct configuration.

products.name: Slack Enterprise+ (Enterprise Grid)
products.data_scope: Full enterprise data including Salesforce CRM data. Enterprise Key Management, full audit logs, legal holds, eDiscovery, data residency, HIPAA/FINRA/FedRAMP configuration.
products.notes: Highest tier. Includes all compliance certifications. HIPAA, FedRAMP Moderate, FINRA configurations available. Agentforce and Salesforce-native AI integrations.

products.name: GovSlack
products.data_scope: Same as Enterprise Grid but with FedRAMP JAB High authorization. US government and public sector use.
products.notes: Separate product for government customers. FedRAMP JAB High authorized, pursuing DoD CC SRG IL4. Separate SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 reports available.

products.name: Slack AI (feature set)
products.data_scope: Accesses only workspace data the user already has permission to view. Uses RAG; no data retained by LLM after each request.
products.notes: Slack AI is not a standalone product but a feature layer across paid plans. Includes: channel recaps, thread summaries, AI-powered search, Slackbot agent, huddle notes, web search via Slackbot, chart generation. Available on Business+ and Enterprise+ (and some features on Pro).

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid tiers (Pro, Business+, Enterprise+). Enterprise Grid requires custom contract. AI features bundled in Business+ and Enterprise+ as of June 2025 (no longer a separate add-on).
compare.data_residency: Enterprise Grid and Enterprise+ plans: customers can choose US or EU (and potentially other regions) for encrypted data at rest. Not available on Free or Pro plans.

flags: Penetration testing schedule not publicly disclosed; consider requesting via enterprise sales process.
Traditional ML models (non-generative, e.g., emoji/channel recommendations) do use workspace data in aggregate by default; opt-out requires emailing feedback@slack.com — admins should be aware.
Data residency (choosing storage region) is restricted to Enterprise Grid plans only. Free and Pro customers have no regional control.
Slack AI is part of a Salesforce-owned platform; Salesforce integration means CRM data may be accessible to AI features on Enterprise+ plans — review Salesforce data governance in conjunction.
ISO 42001 (AI management system) is confirmed on the security page; this is a notable differentiator for AI-specific compliance requirements.
GovSlack is a distinct SKU from commercial Slack; organizations with FedRAMP High requirements must purchase GovSlack separately.
